sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:41156  CRL.P No. 11277 of 2023  ORDER

The petitioner who is apprehending arrest in Crime No.143/2022 registered by Madivala Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 506, 419, 420, 468, 471 R/w 34 of IPC is before this Court under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
2. Heard the learned Counsel appearing for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.143/2022 was registered by Madivala Police Station for the aforesaid offences based on complaint dated 01.08.2022 lodged by Sri Babu S/o Narayana Reddy.

In the complaint it is averred that the complainant had purchased property bearing no.1856/4 situated at Beretena Agrahara village, Begur Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk under a registered sale deed dated 11.02.2020 from accused nos.1 and 2.

It is further averred that subsequently on 09.03.2020 a cancellation deed of the absolute sale deed dated 11.02.2020 was executed without knowledge of complainant and the property which is subject matter of sale deed dated 11.02.2020 was subsequently sold by accused nos.1 and 2 in favour of NC: 2023:KHC:41156 accused no.3.
It is alleged that the officials of sub registrar office have colluded with accused nos.1 to 3 and had committed fraud.
It is in this background, the complainant had approached the police and lodged a complaint dated 01.08.2022 which had resulted in registering FIR in Crime no.143/2022.
Apprehending arrest in the said case, the petitioner had filed Crl.Misc.10088/2023 which was dismissed on 27.10.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is not arrayed as accused in the complaint and there is no allegation as against him in the complaint.
He is not a party either to sale deed dated 11.02.2020 or to the cancellation deed dated 09.03.2020.
The police for extraneous reason are coming near the house of the petitioner and threatening to arrest him.

Accordingly, he prayed to allow the petition.
5.
Learned HCGP appearing for respondent - State has opposed the bail application.

From a perusal of complaint averments it is seen that allegation of fraud by executing the cancellation deed NC: 2023:KHC:41156 dated 09.03.2020 is made as against accused nos.1 and 2 and the officials of BTM sub registrar office.
It is further averred in the complaint that subsequently accused nos.1 and 2 have sold the site in question in favour of accused no.3.
Based on the averment made in the complaint, FIR was registered in Crime No.143/2022 against accused nos.1 to 3 and sub registrar of BTM and others.
There is no allegation in the complaint as against the petitioner herein.
7. Undisputedly the petitioner is not a party to any of the documents which was registered before the sub registrar office of BTM Layout in respect of site in question.
Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the prayer made by the petitioner for grant of discretionary relief of anticipatory bail is required to be answered affirmatively.
8. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioner in the event of his arrest in Crime No.143/2022 registered by Madivala Police Station, Bengaluru City for the offences punishable under NC:
2023:KHC:41156 Sections 504, 506, 419, 420, 468, 471 R/w 34 of IPC subject to the following conditions:
a.

The petitioner shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh only)
with one surety for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
b. The petitioner shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.

c. The petitioner shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and he shall co- operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon till filing of charge sheet/final report.
